title: Spaarke Provisioning Intake
description: Batch-mode intake schema for /provision-environment skill Step 1 (`--batch <path.json>`). Authored by customer-provisioning-orchestration-r1 task 203c per punch-list row A03. Consumed by the skill's Step 1.0 batch-mode path (validated with ajv-cli or equivalent Draft 2020-12 validator BEFORE POST /api/runs). Section 1f (environmentId auto-create) still runs when `environmentId` is omitted / null.

customerId.description: kebab-case, 3-32 chars, starts with letter (matches skill Step 1a and L2 API validation)

tenantId.description: Customer Entra tenant ID (Model 2) or Spaarke tenant ID (Model 1). NEVER default — enforces §4D I1 (FR-28) tenant-isolation invariant.

subscriptionId.description: Target Azure subscription id. REQUIRED for Model2Dedicated (customer's own subscription per ADR-027 D4 subscription-per-customer). Model1Shared MAY omit — the skill auto-defaults to the Spaarke shared subscription at CreateRun time. Consumed by H1/H2a/H2b/H4/H4b/H4Shared/H8/H9/H13/H14 via nonSecretParameters['subscriptionId']. Missing at H1 dispatch → hard-stop with MissingSubscriptionId within ~20s of a Model 2 run; operator's only recovery is a manual Cosmos edit (no post-CreateRun add-nonSecret endpoint). Fail-fast in intake instead. Validated by the Model2Dedicated allOf below.

tenancyModel.description: Model1Shared = shared trial/SMB tier; Model2Dedicated = dedicated sub + dedicated Dataverse + admin-consent flow

environment.description: Session-level env — determines which L2 API base + which Bicep parameter file (NOT the L2 profile enum below)

profile.description: L2 API profile enum — MUST match L2 accepted values EXACTLY (per DS-5 c6-1). Any drift = L2 400.

environmentId.description: sprk_dataverseenvironment record GUID. Omit or null → skill Step 1f auto-creates the placeholder via Dataverse MCP (primary) or `pac data create` (fallback).

region.description: Azure region for platform resources. Canonical Spaarke strategy: westus2 for platform, westus3 for OpenAI (per user-memory reference_azure_fresh_sub_regional_gotchas). Optional — inferred from tenancyModel default when omitted.

openAiRegion.description: Azure region for Azure OpenAI deployment. Defaults to westus3 per canonical Spaarke strategy (westus2 platform + westus3 OpenAI, see operator memory reference_azure_fresh_sub_regional_gotchas). Consumed by customer.bicep openAiLocation param. Override only when data-residency or single-region compliance requires it (co-location typically saves 5-15 dollars per month trial egress but adds ~15-25ms per AI call, negligible vs inference time). Cross-referenced with PRQ-E-13 preflight (scripts/provisioning-prereqs/prereqs.yaml) which verifies pinned model:version pairs are available + non-Deprecated in the chosen region BEFORE dispatch.

tier.description: Cost-envelope tier hint for H0 preflight cost-envelope check. Optional.

skipExternalPrereqs.description: Opt-in bypass of Step 0.5 (prereqs.yaml iteration). Use ONLY when operator has manually verified every once_per_tenant + once_per_subscription + once_per_env prereq per docs/guides/PROVISIONING-PREREQUISITES.md. Documented in lessons-learned.md when set true.

notes.description: Free-form intake notes archived to provisioning-runs/{customerId}-{runId}/intake.md. Optional.

confirmationAcknowledgment.description: REQUIRED for batch dispatch. Literal attestation phrase — batch equivalent of the interactive Step 3 confirmation gate. Per wave-0-adr-note-2026-08-27.md Decision 3 (BAT-03): NFR-11 auditability preserved via two-layer evidence — (1) operator TYPED the phrase into the intake file (typing = intent expression); (2) SHA-256 hash of the intake JSON is captured in the L2 audit record + Step 7 postmortem. Interactive mode still requires stdin-typed phrase per skill Step 3 (unchanged). Any value other than the exact literal MUST cause the skill to HARD STOP before POST /api/runs.

mcpDisconnectPolicy.description: Batch policy for skill Step 0d Dataverse MCP disconnect (BAT-04). `failFast` → exit non-zero with runs/{runId}-mcp-disconnect.json diagnostic. `proceedWithFallback` → use `pac data` + raw Web API PS fallback path (Fallback Matrix F1). Ignored in interactive mode (operator answers yes/no prompt).

acknowledgeUpgradeMode.description: Batch acknowledgement that customerId may have prior runs (BAT-05). If Step 1a upgrade probe finds a `sprk_dataverseenvironment` row with `sprk_provisionedon != null` AND this flag is false → HARD STOP with runs/{runId}-upgrade-required.json. Set true only when operator has consciously chosen upgrade-mode semantics per §14A upgrade model. Ignored in interactive mode (operator answers upgrade-confirmation prompt).

onFailedPolicy.description: Batch policy for skill Step 4b Failed row (BAT-07). `autoResumeOnce` → POST /api/runs/{id}/resume ONCE after Failed → if still Failed, exit non-zero. `abandon` → immediately write runs/{runId}-failed.json + exit non-zero (skips resume). Ignored in interactive mode (operator answers resume/abandon prompt).

onQuarantinedPolicy.description: Batch policy for skill Step 4b Quarantined row (BAT-07). ALWAYS `failFast` in batch (enum-of-one for forward compat) — write structured JSON diagnostic to runs/{runId}-quarantine.json and exit with distinct non-zero code (3). Quarantine is never auto-cleared in batch mode; operator MUST manually invoke QuarantineClearService via a separate maintenance workflow.

onManualGatePolicy.description: Batch policy for skill Step 5 Manual Gate Handling (BAT-08). `waitAndExit` → write runs/{runId}-WAITING.md + runs/{runId}-gate.json + exit code 4 (operator resumes via `--resume` flag after clearing gate). `pollUntilTimeout` → poll GET /api/runs/{id} at 10s cadence until gate clears or configured timeout (currently 30 min hard-cap); exit 0 on clear, exit 4 on timeout. `failFast` → immediately exit code 4 (no wait, no polling). Applies to H0.5 admin consent · H1 quota bump · H8 SPE 24h · any WaitingOnGate transition.

costEnvelopePolicy.description: Batch policy for H0 preflight cost-envelope check (COMP-10). `abortOnOverrun` → H0 fail-fast if projected monthly cost exceeds tier ceiling; run enters Failed(cost-overrun) before any side-effecting handler dispatches. `warnAndProceed` → log warning to runs/{runId}-cost-warning.json but continue dispatch (Model 1 shared-trial ONLY — MUST reject for Model2Dedicated + prod). Default `abortOnOverrun` per binding NFR intent.

postmortemFile.description: Optional path to a pre-authored lessons-learned template (BAT-09). If provided + valid → skill Step 7b uses as base and appends run-specific data. If provided + invalid (missing required sections) → HARD STOP with runs/{runId}-postmortem-invalid.json. If omitted → skill auto-generates minimum lessons-learned.md from run outcome. Path is relative to repo root.

allOf.description: tenancyModel × profile invariant — Model1Shared pairs ONLY with spaarke-hosted-model1-trial
tenancyModel × profile invariant — Model2Dedicated pairs with spaarke-hosted-model2 or customer-owned-model2

ISH-02 — subscriptionId REQUIRED for Model2Dedicated (customer's own subscription per ADR-027 D4). Model1Shared runs auto-default the Spaarke shared sub-id in-skill at CreateRun time, so subscriptionId is OPTIONAL at intake for Model 1.

examples.notes: First E2E Model 1 platform stand-up — permanent trial env (per SESSION 11 Q4 BINDING).
